subsection.name: Introduction
subsection.p: This library simplify the access to the data of the workflow. It centralizes workflow services through workflowBeans.

subsection.name: Configuration
subsection.p: Inject the workflowBeanService corresponding to the adequate ressource workflow
subsection.pre: <bean id="identityimport.batchWFBean.wfbeanservice" class="fr.paris.lutece.plugins.identityimport.wf.WorkflowBeanService"> <constructor-arg index="0" value="IDENTITYIMPORT_BATCH_RESOURCE" /> <constructor-arg index="1" type="int"> <value>1 </value> </constructor-arg> <!-- : the worlkflow ID (key) --> </bean>

subsection.name: Usage
subsection.p: Template integration : the workflowBean is a resource wrapper thats provides the state and the available actions for the resource :
subsection.pre: <@box> <@boxHeader title='Workflow' /> <@boxBody> statut : <#if batchWFBean.state??> <@tag color='warning'>${batchWFBean.state.name} <#else> not set <#else>no action History : ${batchWFBean.history! }
subsection.p: JSPBean integration : the workflowBean can be created with _wfBeanService.createWorkflowBean()
